facts.fact_text: According to the applicant, on 6 May 2012 he arrived at Kaluzhskaya Square in Moscow to take part in the 'March of Millions'.

According to the applicant, at around 6.50 p.m. on 6 May 2012 he found himself near Malyy Kamennyy Bridge in a crowd surrounded by police officers who were beating the protestors with truncheons and arresting them.
According to the applicant, a police officer attacked him using a truncheon on 6 May 2012.
According to the applicant, he was outraged and scared as a result of the police officer's attack.
According to the applicant, he tried to protect himself from the blows by extending his arms forward and distancing himself from the police.
According to the applicant, four police officers eventually grabbed him and escorted him to a police car, which took him to a police station.

The Zamoskvoretskiy District Court of Moscow held that between 5 p.m. and 10 p.m. on 6 May 2012 the applicant took part in acts of mass disorder accompanied by violence against police officers and the destruction of property.
On 22 October 2014 the police questioned the applicant about the events of 6 May 2012.
On 22 October 2014 the applicant was arrested.
On 26 February 2015 the Basmannyy District Court of Moscow ordered the applicant's house arrest until 6 April 2015.

On 27 February 2015 charges were brought against the applicant under Article 212 § 2 of the Criminal Code of the Russian Federation (participation in acts of mass disorder accompanied by violence and destruction of property).
On 27 February 2015 charges were brought against the applicant under Article 318 § 1 of the Criminal Code of the Russian Federation (use of violence against a public official).

On 3 April 2015 charges were brought against the applicant under Article 212 § 2 of the Criminal Code of the Russian Federation (participation in acts of mass disorder accompanied by violence and destruction of property).
On 3 April 2015 charges were brought against the applicant under Article 318 § 1 of the Criminal Code of the Russian Federation (use of violence against a public official).
The charges stated that the applicant had hit Police Officer K. at least once in the left hand.
The charges stated that the applicant had hit Police Officer G. twice in the left hand.
The charges stated that the applicant had hit Police Officer K. in the head with his umbrella at least once.
The charges stated that the applicant's actions had caused both Police Officer K. and Police Officer G. physical pain.
